{"metadata":{"description":"A library for patching, replacing and decorating dsh plugin during runtime","id":"gh:1334136067","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-harmony","slug":"memorax-ai/dsh-harmony","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","harmony","nodejs","runtime-patching","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A library for patching, replacing and decorating dsh plugin during runtime"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-harmony"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Runtime Patch coordination for DeepSeek Harness plugins."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A library for patching, replacing and decorating DeepSeek Harness plugins during runtime."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Get started"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Documentation"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Report an issue"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"简体中文 / English"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Just type *"What about we use dsh-harmony"* when vibe coding your DSH plugin."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Introduction"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Use Harmony when one DeepSeek Harness plugin needs to change another without maintaining a fork. Har"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"mony loads Patches before the target runs, changes its compiled code in memory, and starts Harness w"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"hes before the target runs, changes its compiled code in memory, and starts Harness with the result."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Source Patches find TypeScript AST nodes with TSQuery and rewrite their source ranges with MagicStri"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ng. They run one after another, each reading the source left by the previous Patch. This lets severa"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"l plugins change the same target while leaving installed files untouched."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"A provider can place its Patches before or after another provider. One Patch may override that rule,"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" and users may interleave Patches from different providers. When several changes must succeed togeth"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"er, a composite Patch gives them one position and one switch; if a member fails, Harmony applies non"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"osite Patch gives them one position and one switch; if a member fails, Harmony applies none of them."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"For browser plugins, Harmony also keeps provider-owned `<style data-plugin>` tags in Patch order. A "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"provider owns one style group, so its last enabled Patch decides where that group appears in the CSS"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" cascade. Harmony repeats the ordering after a Patch reload."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Harmony binds each new session to the ordered enabled Patch profile that created it, including provi"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"der versions and Patch-content fingerprints. The shared DSH data root stores these bindings in `harm"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ony-sessions.json`, leaving DSH session artifacts unchanged. Before Web loads a tracked session, Har"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"mony compares that binding with the current profile; a mismatch shows the missing, added, changed, o"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"r reordered Patches and lets you return without loading the session."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Harmony also records the last ordered Patch profile that started the shared DSH instance in `$DSH_HO"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ME/harmony-instance.json`. Every startup compares its current profile with that data-side record. A "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"mismatch is logged and shown in Web before the record advances to the running configuration, so a pr"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ofile switch or Patch change is visible once at the point it starts touching the shared sessions, at"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"tachments, workspace metadata, and other storage under the same DSH home."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Harmony adds modification to the ways DeepSeek Harness plugins can work together."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Why Harmony"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Ordinary DSH extension points remain the first choice when the target exposes the behavior you need."},{"id":"p20s2","text":" Harmony is for the gap between those APIs and maintaining a fork: changing an internal component, l"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"oader entry, or compiled behavior that the target does not expose."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Without Harmony | With Harmony |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Hide or duplicate an internal UI and keep both implementations aligned | Replace the selected comp"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"onent or compiled call site in place |
| Patch `node_modules`, carry a fork, or reapply edits after "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"upgrades | Transform source in memory; installed package files remain byte-for-byte unchanged |
| Di"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"scover a selector drift only after the UI silently breaks | Pin package version and `expect`; versio"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"n drift warns while a real match failure fails visibly in `status` |
| Treat the final bundle as a b"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"lack box | Inspect the original, every Patch step, and the final transformed source |
| Remove custo"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"m edits manually | Disable or remove the Provider to restore the original behavior |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Harmony does not turn compiled internals into a stable public API. It makes that dependency explicit"},{"id":"p23s2","text":", ordered, inspectable, and reversible."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Respect**"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Inspired by Harmony, the project of the same name created by Andreas Pardeike and other contributors"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" by Harmony, the project of the same name created by Andreas Pardeike and other contributors for C#."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"AI agents: use the repository skill"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Load `use-dsh-harmony` for installation, Patch selection and authoring, runtime operations, and trou"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"h-harmony` for installation, Patch selection and authoring, runtime operations, and troubleshooting."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Requires Node.js `^22.15.0` or `>=23.5.0` and a current `@deepseek-ai/dsh` installation. Harmony sup"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ports both legacy self-executing DSH entries and newer `runCli()` entries, and normalizes Windows na"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"mespaced paths during profile discovery. The legacy integration lane stays below `0.1.2`; the modern"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" lanes cover `>=0.1.2-alpha.4 <0.1.8-0` and `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1-0`. Compatible releases in these la"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"nes need no Harmony upgrade merely because their version changes. Versions outside the lanes are sti"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ll attempted with visible drift warnings and exact-match checks; installation is not blocked. If ups"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"tream changes an interface or Patch target, upgrade Harmony for the corresponding adapter."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Patch model"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Plugin compatibility"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Any DSH plugin package can describe its relationships with other plugins under `dsh.plugin.compatibi"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"lity`, whether or not it provides Harmony Patches:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`requires` reports a missing, inactive, or incompatible dependency; `conflicts` warns when an incomp"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"atible pair is active; and `integrates` reports an available optional integration. These declaration"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"s never install, enable, disable, or block plugins. Targets are package names and values are semver "},{"id":"p36s4","text":"ranges. Reciprocal conflict declarations produce one warning, and disabling a Harmony Patch does not"},{"id":"p36s5","text":" disable its owning plugin."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"When a plugin must activate another Harmony Provider's bundle, declare it under `dsh.harmony.require"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"s`. Harmony resolves it from the requiring package, adds its bundle as a temporary startup layer, an"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"d reuses an already configured bundle instead of creating a duplicate Loader entry. The dependency m"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"ust still be installed by the package manager."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Live reports use the plugins active in Loader. When the profile is stopped, Harmony can only inspect"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" its installation and therefore treats installed profile packages as active."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## Load coordination"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
